description: Founder approves outcomes and material decisions. Codex organizes internal tasks and phases autonomously; quality evidence is required at goal closure.
notice: Local checks validate structure only. Founder approval, independent review identity, real skill execution and real-world test performance require external verification.
ui_uat_policy: On any UI-impacting Goal, Codex must complete per-interface pre-UAT with proof before READY_FOR_REVIEW; Founder final acceptance per interface required for VERIFIED. Structural metadata is not authenticated test execution.
ui_design_policy: Every UI-impacting Goal needs an Owner-approved design contract with per-interface reference screenshots, task workflows and a separate reviewer. Structural validation checks declarations, not aesthetic quality, true approval or reviewer independence. Design identity changes require fresh Founder approval.
ui_experience_policy: Experience-first: derive each UI journey from a real user role and outcome before UI layout and before binding Frappe/ERP data. Present only meaningful business inputs; internal DocType IDs and system configuration must be hidden or justified, not rendered by default. Independently test scenario completion with user-language actions and results; database integrity remains authoritative.
